notes:
Lead source: inbound from blog article 'Search + RAG for small legal teams' (SEO). Small team (12 engineers + lawyers). Initial use case: internal knowledge search over contracts and precedent docs. Most traffic in NA. They signed up for self-serve, started with Hosted API trial credits.

Quick summary / quote: "We need short-answer retrieval for legal memos — speed matters, but we can't leak contracts." — CTO (A. Mehta). Wants to avoid dedicated infra for now; prefers public cloud + Redwood hosted if costs look good.

Technical details asked on call (3/3):
- Dataset size: ~500k small docs (sections/clause-level), expect 50k vectors initially, up to 500k in 6 months.
- Throughput target: 20–40 qps peak for search endpoint (embedding lookup + 3–5 candidate rerank).
- Latency SLO: ~150–300ms median for search responses (end-to-end); willing to accept higher tail for heavy reranks.
- Cost sensitivity: moderate — SMB budget but willing to pay for reliability; looking to keep cost per query < $0.05 initially.
- Preferred models: open embeddings (dense, 1536 dims) or Redwood-verified small footprint embeddings. Interested in guidance on quantized options later.
- Rerank approach: curious about running neural reranker vs hybrid BM25+embedding rerank. Wants example metrics and token cost tradeoffs.
- Vector DB integration: uses Pinecone in POC but asks about best practices for upserts, batch size, latency tuning, idempotent ingestion. Also asked whether Redwood provides direct connector snippets for Pinecone/Weaviate.
- Data residency/retention: they want 90-day ephemeral storage for embeddings, legal team flagged PII in docs — asked about KMS + ability to purge vectors on demand.

Sales/ops notes:
- They self-serveed to test basic search; trial usage shows ~1k queries so far.
- Next deliverable from AE: send concise quickstart with 3 code snippets (Python: embedding->upsert->search, Node: streaming generation, curl example) + recommended batch sizes.
- SE action: provide connector examples to Pinecone + Weaviate and a short note on rerank tradeoffs (neural vs hybrid) with rough token-cost calc. Include sample micro-benchmark numbers for 1536-dim embeddings.
- Legal asked for SOC2 docs and a short summary of retention + purge APIs before approving invoice. Put security FAQ link in Drive (drive.google.com/file/d/1Security-FAQ-Lotus).

Personality / fit: pragmatic, engineering-led, values clear examples and costs. Good PLG candidate — likely to convert to $1k–$10k ARR if initial latency/cost targets met.

Staged risks: slow legal signoff on SOC2 + retention controls; if we can't provide concrete purge/KMS guidance quickly they may pause.

Suggested playbook: prioritize sending quick wins: 1) sample upsert/search code for Pinecone; 2) mini-cost model for 100k queries/month; 3) SOC2 excerpt + purge API steps. Keep cadence 1x/week until legal cleared.
